prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: low-speed head-on collision in League City, Texas. Injury: neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1194; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was driving home on a weekday afternoon when a car came into my lane on a slight curve and we collided head-on. Both of us were moving slowly, I think under twenty miles per hour, but the impact pushed my head back and then forward, and my airbag did not deploy. I stayed at the scene until the officer arrived and I told the same account to him, to the other driver, and later to the adjuster on the phone, with no changes to the sequence of events. I have been the named driver on this policy for several years and I have held continuous coverage with the company throughout. Since the collision I have had stiffness and soreness in my neck and lower back, and I have been seeing a physical therapist twice a week to manage the strain. I am submitting this statement so the claim can be reviewed, and I am willing to provide any further records needed.
